functional_semantics.triton: y = x * 2 elementwise into a fresh empty_like buffer, same dtype (impl_triton.py 14-16, 33).
functional_semantics.cutile: y = x * 2 elementwise into a fresh empty_like buffer, same dtype (impl_cutile.py 18-20, 34).
functional_semantics.note: Both realise the reference x * 2 (impl_torch.py 5) with the literal 2 applied to the loaded tile.

stages.triton: One kernel, one launch of ceil(n / tile) programs: load, multiply, store (impl_triton.py 8-16, 35-44).
stages.cutile: One kernel, one launch of ceil(n / tile) CTAs: load, multiply, store (impl_cutile.py 15-20, 56-57).

precision.triton: Single multiply by the scalar 2 on the loaded tile, stored in the input dtype; exact for every floating dtype and for int8 within the generator's range (impl_triton.py 15-16; tensors.py 70-72).
precision.cutile: Single multiply by the scalar 2 on the loaded tile, stored in the input dtype; same exactness (impl_cutile.py 19-20).
precision.note: Doubling is exact in fp16/bf16/fp32 and exact for the bounded int8 inputs; neither source saturates on int8 overflow and the generator avoids it.

preprocessing.triton: n_elements = x.numel(); output = empty_like(x); x passed as-is (impl_triton.py 32-33).
preprocessing.cutile: output = empty_like(x); n_elements = x.numel(); x passed as-is (impl_cutile.py 34-35).
preprocessing.note: Only the output allocation on both sides.

mutation.triton: x is read-only; fresh output every call (impl_triton.py 14, 33).
mutation.cutile: x is read-only; fresh output every call (impl_cutile.py 18, 34).
mutation.note: Neither side mutates the input; the contract forbids mutation.

hardware_dispatch.note: Single code path on both sides.

fq_boundary.note: Both timed run() bodies read n elements once and write n elements once with no preprocessing traffic and nothing prepacked, exactly what bytes_expr counts; flops_expr counts the one multiply per element (config.yaml 14-15).
